pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 64 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Rupture, growing with the tier, up to +6.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 4.

Will not count without:$(li)1 of Sculk Catalyst$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Sculk Catalyst$(li)Sculk Shrieker$(li)Sculk Sensor$(li)Sculk$(li)Sculk Vein$(p)Counts against it:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(li)any crops$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Shell is carved rather than squared off, and growth is within 8 of catalyst.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Shell: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#structural)any structural$(/l)$(li)Growth: Sculk or Sculk Vein$(li)Catalyst: Sculk Catalyst
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: And rooms that do not go with it - each one costs this room while it stands there:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/purifying_font)Purifying Font$(/l), within 10 blocks
pages.title: Rooms that do not
